Prevention and Treatment

There is no specific treatment for HMPV. Most people recover on their own within a week or two. Prevention measures include frequent handwashing, avoiding close contact with sick people, and staying home when sick.

Ongoing Situation

The situation is still developing, and health authorities in China are monitoring the outbreak closely. It's important to stay informed about the latest developments and take precautions to protect yourself and others.
